name: EMT grounding investigation: complete retained cohorts

variants.label: First gallery revision (known remaining grounding issue)
Explicit identity tokens and calibrated answer instructions

notes: Question files and references are unchanged; A/B labels were randomized independently per question and source/model labels hidden from paired reviewers.
Grades remain AI-assisted with human verification pending. These are previously seen development clips and annotated tracks, not held-out/trained-model results.
Changes include visual selection, general grounding instructions and provider-default sampling; differences do not establish one causal effect.

In the first gallery revision, QA passes were rescued by incidental full-scene pixels: the pickup-motion question still highlighted van1. That note concerns the first revision; the latest revision correctly selects pickup6.
The first revision retains an overconfident light-car colour and some control failures. All original and revised outputs are preserved.
The initial grade categories were rechecked while still blinded against the predeclared uncertainty/confidence definitions; raw initial judgments remain local.
No separate retrieval answer key is supplied; content passes are not ranking accuracy.
The latest complete small-model cohort fixes the original six QA cases and pickup identity, but introduces four previous-pass losses. It is not regression-free and remains in draft.
The twelve separately frozen development controls are reviewed outside this original35-question ordinary denominator; their latest results are12passes.
Stronger-reviewer diagnostics use saved selection and are not substituted into either complete cohort. Their full-cohort verification is separate.
The same reference was re-reviewed independently in both paired rounds; baseline grade labels agree question-by-question.
The latest supplemental second-02 retrieval still highlights pickup6 rather than opening cage truck17; correct direction words do not establish correct target selection.
